Name: RainPlus
Author: deadlykirpy
Description:
RainPlus defaults to making every Wednesday rain.


After installing this mod, run SDV once to generate the config.json.  

Config.Json options

UseMax: Toggles using a maximum number of days between the last time it rains instead of setting a day of the week to rain.
MaxDays: Sets the maximum number of days before it rains.
RainDay: Sets the day of the week to rain.
Debug: Logs to the SMAPI console on the start of a new day, or use of the rain command.
UseGreet: Lets the user set custom greetings on the start of a new day.
Greetings: List of custom greetings user can add.

Manifest.Name: RainPlus
Manifest.Description: Lets it rain once a week
